queries_run: Apple 10-K 2026 customer concentration carriers trade receivables net sales 10% customer
Apple carrier partner Verizon AT&T T-Mobile credit rating downgrade 2026

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：有一家客戶占應收帳款 10% 以上，2026 年 13%、2025 年 12%；電信業者合計占應收 33%（前一年 34%）；公司對部分客戶要求第三方信用支持或擔保品。
findings.excerpt: As of both September 26, 2026 and September 27, 2025, the Company had one customer that represented 10% or more of total trade receivables, which accounted for 13% and 12%, respectively. The Company’s third-party cellular network carriers accounted for 33% and 34% of total trade receivables as of September 26, 2026 and September 27, 2025, respectively. The Company requires third-party credit support or collateral from certain customers to limit credit risk.

findings.claim: FY2026 經間接通路（電信業者、經銷商等）的淨銷售約占總淨銷售 60%。
findings.excerpt: During 2026, the Company’s net sales through its indirect distribution channels accounted for approximately 60% of total net sales.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 未讀到 FY2026 單一客戶占淨銷售 10% 的聲明；搜尋未見 2026 年 Verizon／AT&T／T-Mobile 信評機構降評或 Apple 信評變動（僅見股票分析師評等調整，非信用評等）。
